description: x * n / d computed as (x / d) * n + (x % d) * n / d to avoid overflowing x * n (mult_frac)
notes: Linux kernel v6.11, mult_frac macro (include/linux/math.h), instantiated with u32 operands. Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps udiv, urem, two mul and a second udiv: 7 IR instructions. Division by zero is UB in the source. (x % d) * n can wrap, so the result differs from the exact 64-bit x * n / d for some inputs (e.g. x = 2, n = 2^31, d = 3), and a widened multiply-divide is not a valid rewrite. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
